privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data {bdeName} collects about its members, why, and how to exercise your rights. This text is generic and should be adapted by your organization if needed.

dataCollected.title: Data collected
dataCollected.description: When you sign in via 42, we receive and store:
dataCollected.note: This information is resynced from the 42 API on every sign-in.

purpose.title: Why we collect it
purpose.description: It's used solely to manage access and activity within the organization: identifying members, managing roles and permissions, and keeping an audit trail of sensitive actions.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.description: Your data is kept for as long as you're a member. When an administrator removes you, your account is deleted; some historical records (like the audit log) keep your login as plain text, with no link to an account, for accountability. Events you created, were in charge of or are the organizer of on the intra keep your login as plain text (when the Events module is enabled). So do the notification templates you edited (and their successive versions) and the people you added to the list of mentions. So do the requests to publish events on the intra that you sent or answered, and the copy of what was published (which names the organizer).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.description: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data from an administrator or owner at any time. You can also export a copy of your own data yourself below.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Only technical cookies are used, none for tracking or analytics: the session cookie (up to 30 days), which keeps you signed in; short security cookies set while you sign in with 42; and a cookie that remembers your language. Your theme choice (light or dark) is kept in the browser, without a cookie.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: For any question, contact an administrator or owner of {bdeName}.
contact.withAddress: For any question or to exercise your rights, write to

export.title: Export my data
export.description: Download a copy of everything we hold about you, as JSON.

notifications.title: Emails and notifications
notifications.description: Your email address is also used to write to you: if your club has turned on email, you may receive one when your access is approved, when an event is confirmed, or the day before an event you are in charge of. Owners and the members who can approve access receive new requests. Messages may also be posted in the club's Discord or Slack channel: they mention the name and login of the people concerned (new request, member approved or removed). When the platform publishes events on the intra, you can also enter your Discord and/or Slack id in your profile (optional): it is only used to mention you in the messages for the staff, nobody else sees it, it is deleted with your account and you can erase it at any time.

calendar.title: Personal calendar link
calendar.description: If the Events module is turned on, a personal subscription link (a random code) is created for your calendar. Anyone who has this link can read the events you are allowed to see: do not share it. You can replace it at any time from "My profile"; it stops working if your account is deleted.

campuses.title: Campuses
campuses.description: Only members of these 42 campuses will be able to ask for access. Choose your school's campus or campuses.
campuses.allHelp: No filter: any 42 student can ask for access.
campuses.mainHelp: It gives the time zone of events.
campuses.manualHelp: The list of campuses could not be loaded. Write the exact name of the campus, as on the intra (for example "Nice").

owners.title: Owners
owners.description: Owners have every right from their first sign-in. Give at least your 42 login: it is checked with 42.
owners.unknownBody: 42 could not answer. Check the spelling: a wrong login could never sign in.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Choose what the platform offers from the start. You can change it later.
modules.eventsBody: The BDE's calendar, reminders the day before, calendar subscription.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: The platform can tell the board and the members: a new access request, a confirmed event, reminders. Set up the channels you use, then tick what goes where. You can change everything later.
notifications.channelsHelp: A channel has to be set up before it can be ticked in the table. Each channel is independent: if one is down, the others still send.

channelBodies.discord: A message in a channel of your server.
channelBodies.slack: A message in a channel of your workspace.
channelBodies.email: E-mails sent by your mail server (SMTP).

notifications.removalPending: {channel} will be removed when you save: its boxes will be cleared.
notifications.discordHelp: In Discord: channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks, New webhook, then "Copy webhook URL".
notifications.slackHelp: Create a Slack app, turn on "Incoming Webhooks" and copy the webhook address (see the notifications documentation).
notifications.testOk: Test sent on {channel}: check that it arrived. It is the real presentation, with an invented event.
notifications.matrixHelp: One row per notification, one column per channel. A row with no box ticked sends nothing.

memberPending.name: Access request waiting
memberPending.hint: Tells the owners and whoever can approve it.

memberApproved.name: Request approved
memberApproved.hint: Tells the member by e-mail, and the team in the channel.

memberRemoved.name: Member removed
memberRemoved.hint: A message in the channel: the person removed never gets an e-mail.

eventConfirmed.name: Event confirmed
eventConfirmed.hint: Tells every member, once per event.

eventReminder.name: Event reminder
eventReminder.hint: The day before, to the people in charge (or to those who validate when nobody is).

eventRefused.name: Proposal refused
eventRefused.hint: Tells its author, with the comment.

intraRequested.name: Publication requested
intraRequested.hint: Tells the school's staff: an e-mail to those who can publish, a message in its room.

intraChanged.name: Event changed on the intra
intraChanged.hint: Tells the staff, with the old and the new value.

intraCancelled.name: Event taken back from the intra
intraCancelled.hint: Tells the staff that a published event is no longer to be published.

intraPublished.name: Published on the intra
intraPublished.hint: Tells the author, and the BDE's room.

intraRefused.name: Publication refused
intraRefused.hint: Tells the author, with the reason, and the BDE's room.

backupFailed.name: Backup failed
backupFailed.hint: Tells the owners when the night's backup fails, once a day.

backupStale.name: No backup for 2 days
backupStale.hint: Tells the owners, once a day, as long as no backup has succeeded.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Check before installing. Nothing is saved before the button below.
summary.name: Name
summary.incomplete: An answer is missing: go back to the previous steps.
summary.invalid: These settings do not make a valid platform ({detail}).

done.title: Platform installed
done.description: All set. Sign in with your 42 account: the owners in the list have every right from their first sign-in.
done.tipBackground: If you ran "docker compose up" without "-d", press Ctrl+C in the terminal, then run "docker compose up -d": the platform will then run in the background.
done.tipBackup: Back up the "secrets" volume with ./scripts/backup.sh: without it, the saved secrets cannot be decrypted after a restore.

test.message: Test message from {name}. If you read it, this channel works.
test.subject: Test from {name}
test.sampleDescription: This is how the notifications of {name} look. No event was created.

errors.wrong: That code is not right. Check the latest code shown by the server.
errors.locked: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.session: The setup session has expired. Enter the code again.
errors.invalid: The data sent is invalid. Reload the page.
errors.incomplete: An answer is missing: go back to the previous steps.
errors.name: The name must be between 1 and 60 characters.
errors.address: Invalid address. Examples: https://bde.my-school.org or http://localhost:3000.
errors.addressUnspecified: 0.0.0.0 is not a site address: it is the address the server listens on. Write http://localhost:3000 for a try-out on this computer, or your site's address (https://bde.my-school.org).
errors.addressNoDot: An address with no dot (like "bde") does not work: 42 sends people back to it and browsers do not reliably keep the sign-in cookie for such a name. Write the full name (https://bde.my-school.org) or the server's IP address (http://192.168.1.10:3000).
errors.insecure: Tick the box to continue with an http:// address.
errors.clientId: The UID must be at least 8 characters, with no space.
errors.clientSecret: The SECRET must be at least 8 characters, with no space or apostrophe.
errors.swapped: The UID and the SECRET look swapped: the UID starts with "u-", the SECRET with "s-".
errors.invalidCredentials: 42 refuses these credentials: the UID and the SECRET are not a valid pair. Copy them again from the application's page (one extra space is enough) and check they come from the same application.
errors.rateLimited: 42 limits the number of requests: wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.network: 42 cannot be reached from this computer ({detail}).
errors.campusNotListed: The BDE's campus must be one of the allowed campuses.
errors.login: A 42 login is made of letters, digits and dashes (40 characters at most).
errors.loginMissing: This login does not exist on the 42 intra.
errors.discord: That is not a Discord webhook address (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…).
errors.slack: That is not a Slack webhook address (https://hooks.slack.com/services/…).
errors.smtpHost: Not a server name (examples: smtp.my-school.org, mailpit, 192.168.1.10). Letters, digits, dots and hyphens, no spaces.
errors.smtpHostScheme: Write only the server name, without "smtp://" or "https://".
errors.smtpHostPath: Write only the server name: remove the path or anything after a "/".
errors.smtpHostPort: The port has its own field: remove the ":" and the number from the server name.
errors.secretChars: This field cannot contain an apostrophe or a line break.
errors.readOnly: The settings are still in files: they cannot be changed here.
errors.storedInvalid: The saved settings are invalid: restore the latest backup of the database.
errors.secretsUnreadable: The saved secrets cannot be read (the "secrets" volume is lost): restore it with scripts/restore.sh --secrets, or use BDE_REIMPORT=settings (see the configuration guide).
errors.conflict: Somebody changed the settings at the same time. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ownerExists: This login is already an owner.
errors.ownerNotFound: This login is not in the list of owners.
errors.ownerSelf: You cannot remove yourself: ask another owner.
errors.tooManyOwners: There are already 30 owners, which is the maximum.
errors.loginUnverified: 42 could not confirm this login: check it, then confirm the addition.
errors.logoTooBig: This file is too large: 2 MB at most.
errors.logoFormat: Format not accepted: send a PNG, a JPEG, a GIF or a WebP (no SVG).
errors.logoSmall: This image is too small: at least 64 pixels on each side.
errors.logoLarge: This image is too large: 4096 pixels on a side at most.
errors.reminderHour: The reminder hour must be between 0 and 23.
errors.categoryLabel: A category name must be between 1 and 40 characters.
errors.categoryDuplicate: Two categories have the same name.
errors.categoryInUse: Events still use "{detail}": choose the category to move them to.
errors.tooManyCategories: There are already 30 categories, which is the maximum.
errors.channelNotConfigured: A box is ticked for a channel that is not set up: set it up first, or clear its boxes.
errors.removedNotEmailed: The person removed never gets an e-mail: clear that box, the message goes in the channel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: The platform's settings, for owners only. Every change applies at once, with no restart, and is written to the audit log.
settings.since: Settings stored in the database, installed on {date}.

readOnly.title: The settings are still in files
readOnly.body: This platform still reads its settings from bde.config.yml and .env, which are not complete: they cannot be changed here. Once those files are completed and the platform restarted, they are copied into the database and this page becomes usable (see the configuration guide).

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: The platform backs itself up every night at 3:00 (the time of your BDE), with nobody doing anything. Each backup is one file that holds the database and the keys to read it, and it is checked right after it is made.

last.title: Last backup
last.restored: Checked: put back into a test database, and its encrypted settings opened with its own keys.
last.read: Checked: opened and compared with its manifest. (This database server does not let the platform make a test database.)
last.noneBody: The first one is made tonight at 3:00. You can also make one now, below.

folder.title: The backups folder cannot be used
folder.missing: This folder does not exist{code, select, none {} other { (code {code})}}.
folder.unreadable: This folder exists but the platform (user {uid}) cannot read it: it belongs to {owner} with rights {mode}.
folder.notWritable: This folder can be read but not written by the platform (user {uid}): it belongs to {owner} with rights {mode}{code, select, none {} other { (code {code})}}.
folder.notMounted: This folder is inside the container, not on the server: the backups would be lost the next time the container is made again.
folder.fixTitle: What to do, on the server

fix.missing: Create the folder {host}, then restart the platform with docker compose up -d.
fix.notDirectory: Replace {host} with an empty folder, then restart with docker compose up -d.
fix.rights: Restart with docker compose up -d: the preparation step gives the folder to the platform. If docker compose logs secrets says the folder cannot be handed to it (a network disk, a folder of another user, Docker without administrator rights), open it as its owner with chmod 1777 {host}, then restart. If that is not enough, choose a folder on a local disk with BDE_BACKUP_DIR in .env.
fix.notMounted: Check that docker-compose.yml is the one of this version (git pull), which mounts {host} on /auto-backups, then restart with docker compose up -d.

stale.title: No backup has succeeded for two days
stale.body: Your data is not protected as it should be. See the reason below, and in the logs of the platform (docker compose logs app).

failure.title: The last attempt failed
failure.body: Reason: {reason} The backups already made are untouched.

reasons.folder: the folder of the backups cannot be written.
reasons.space: there is not enough room on the disk of the backups.
reasons.dump: the database could not be exported.
reasons.secrets: the keys could not be read.
reasons.archive: the archive could not be written.
reasons.verify-archive: the file written is not what its manifest says.
reasons.verify-restore: the export does not load into a test database.
reasons.verify-secrets: the keys of the archive do not open its encrypted settings.

notice.made: The backup was made and checked.
notice.busy: A backup is already running. Try again in a minute.
notice.unavailable: This platform cannot make backups (no database address).

list.title: Backups kept
list.description: 7 daily, 4 weekly and 6 monthly are kept, the others are deleted by themselves.
list.label: Backups kept
list.emptyHint: The first one is made tonight at 3:00.
list.unreadable: The folder of the backups cannot be read. Check BDE_BACKUP_DIR and the rights of the folder.

download.title: Download this backup
download.description: The file is encrypted with a passphrase of your choice. It holds the whole database and the keys: whoever has the file and the passphrase has everything.
download.passphraseHint: 12 characters at least. A few words make a good one.
download.warning: Keep this passphrase. If you lose it, nobody can open the downloaded file again, including us. The backups kept on the server are not affected.
download.restore: To use the file on a new server: ./scripts/restore.sh {file}

errors.tooShort: The passphrase must have at least 12 characters.
errors.tooLong: The passphrase must have at most 200 characters.
errors.mismatch: The two passphrases are not the same.
errors.missing: This backup no longer exists (it was deleted by the rotation?). Reload the page.
errors.generic: The file could not be prepared. Try again.

backups.where: The backups are in the folder “backups/auto” next to docker-compose.yml on the server (BDE_BACKUP_DIR), outside Docker’s volumes: they survive “docker compose down -v”. They are on the same disk as the platform, so copy them somewhere else from time to time.
backups.notTold: No message tells the owners when a backup fails: choose a channel for “Backup failed” and “No backup for 2 days” in the Notifications section below. Without one, they only see it here.

oauthRejected.title: 42 refuses this BDE's application
oauthRejected.body: Nobody can sign in any more: the identifier or the secret of the 42 application were refused (expired or regenerated key?). Check the key at https://profile.intra.42.fr/oauth/applications, then save it in the "42 application" section below.

secrets.lostTitle: The saved secrets can no longer be read
secrets.lostBody: At start-up, the key that decrypts them was not found (the "secrets" volume was lost or replaced). Enter them again below: the 42 application's key, the mail server's password and the webhooks. If you have a backup of the volume, restore it instead with scripts/restore.sh --secrets.
secrets.resealedTitle: The secrets were taken again from .env
secrets.resealedBody: At start-up, the key that decrypts them was not found (the "secrets" volume was lost or replaced). The values present in .env were saved again. Check them below, remove them from .env, and back up the new volume.

owners.title: Owners
owners.description: Owners have every right: members, roles, settings, audit log. Adding or removing an owner takes effect immediately.
owners.cannotRemoveSelf: You cannot remove yourself: ask another owner.
owners.addBody: This person will have every right on the platform, from now on: members, roles, settings and the audit log.
owners.addBodyUnverified: 42 could not confirm that this login exists. Check the spelling: a wrong login could never sign in, and you would believe somebody has every right. This person will have every right from now on.
owners.removeBody: This person loses their owner rights immediately: they become a member with the default role and can no longer change the settings.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: It appears in the menu, on the sign-in page and in the messages sent (Discord, Slack, e-mail).
logo.default: The logo that comes with the platform
logo.requirements: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP · 2 MB at most · 64 to 4096 pixels on a side. A square of at least 512 pixels is ideal.
logo.fileHint: SVG is not accepted: Discord, Slack and mail apps do not display it.
logo.resetTitle: Go back to the default logo?
logo.resetBody: The uploaded logo will be deleted from the server. You can upload another one at any time.

events.title: Events
events.description: The categories offered when an event is created, and the hour of the reminder sent the day before.
events.keepOne: At least one category must stay.
events.pendingTitle: To be removed when you save
events.moveTo: {count, plural, one {Its event will move} other {Its # events will move}} to the category:
events.intraBody: The school's staff publishes the BDE's events on the intra: every event then asks for the fields the staff needs for the intra, and none can be confirmed without them. Turned off, nothing changes.
events.reminderHelp: The reminder goes out the day before each event, at this hour ({timezone} time zone).
events.removeTitle: {count, plural, one {Remove this category?} other {Remove these # categories?}}
events.removeBodyMoved: {count, plural, one {The event concerned is} other {The # events concerned are}} moved to the chosen category right away. This cannot be undone.
events.removeBodyUnused: {count, plural, one {No event uses this category.} other {No event uses these categories.}} Removing cannot be undone.

updates.title: New versions
updates.description: Owners can be told on the dashboard and on this page when a new version of the platform is published.
updates.checkBody: The platform asks GitHub for the latest published version, at most every few hours and only when an owner opens the dashboard or this page. The request carries nothing about your BDE or its members. Turned off, the platform asks nobody.

staffChannel.title: Staff room (optional)
staffChannel.description: The school's staff is not necessarily on the BDE's Discord or Slack. A room of its own, with its own webhook, receives the messages about publishing events on the intra. Without a webhook, those messages go to the BDE's room (with the mentions).
staffChannel.emptyHint: No address: the messages will go to the BDE's room.
staffChannel.willRemove: The address will be removed when you save.

banner.title: Version {latest} is available
banner.howTo: To update, run these two commands in the project folder, one after the other:
banner.commandPull: First command: get the new files
banner.commandUp: Second command: start the new version
banner.backup: The platform makes a copy of its database by itself before changing it. For your own peace of mind, you can also run ./scripts/backup.sh first.

page.title: Notifications
page.intro: Customise the messages the platform sends: the words, the colours, the information shown and its order, the button, the subject of e-mails. What is not changed stays as the platform writes it, and follows its improvements.

eventConfirmed.name: Event confirmed
eventConfirmed.when: Sent once to all members when an event is confirmed.

eventReminder.name: Event reminder
eventReminder.when: Sent the day before, to the members in charge (or to those who validate when there are none).

eventProposed.name: Event proposed
eventProposed.when: Sent to those who can validate when an event is proposed.

eventApproved.name: Proposal validated
eventApproved.when: Sent to the author of the proposal when it is validated.

eventRefused.name: Proposal refused
eventRefused.when: Sent to the author of the proposal, with the comment, when it is refused.

memberPending.name: Access request waiting
memberPending.when: Sent to the owners and to those who manage members when somebody asks for access.

memberApproved.name: Request approved
memberApproved.when: Sent to the member by e-mail, and to the team in the channel, when the request is approved.

memberRemoved.name: Member removed
memberRemoved.when: Sent in the channel when a member is removed. The person removed never receives an e-mail.

intraRequested.name: Publication requested
intraRequested.when: Sent to the school's staff (an e-mail to those who can publish, a message in its room) when an event is confirmed.

intraChanged.name: Event changed on the intra
intraChanged.when: Sent to the staff when an event that is on the intra changes: the old and the new value.

intraCancelled.name: Event taken back from the intra
intraCancelled.when: Sent to the staff when an event on the intra goes back to draft, is deleted or has no date left.

intraPublished.name: Published on the intra
intraPublished.when: Sent to the author (e-mail) and to the BDE's room when the staff published the event.

intraRefused.name: Publication refused
intraRefused.when: Sent to the author (e-mail) and to the BDE's room, with the reason, when the staff refuses.

backupFailed.name: Backup failed
backupFailed.when: Sent to the owners (e-mail) and in the BDE's channel when the night's backup fails, once a day.

backupStale.name: No backup for 2 days
backupStale.when: Sent to the owners (e-mail) and in the BDE's channel, once a day, as long as no backup has succeeded.

editor.followingHelp: This channel sends the message written for all channels. To make it different, customise it: it then starts from a copy of the common template and no longer follows later changes made for all channels.
editor.customiseDescription: This channel will start from a copy of the common template and no longer follow its changes. Going back to the common template is possible at any time.
editor.customiseDescriptionDirty: This channel will start from a copy of the saved common template. Unsaved changes on this page will be lost: better to save first.
editor.customised: {channel} has its own template: changes to the common template no longer apply to it.
editor.backToCommonDescription: The template of {channel} is removed: this channel follows the common template again. It stays in the history.
editor.ownMessage: This channel has its own message: the common template does not apply to it.
editor.nothingChanged: Nothing to save: the template is already this one
editor.resetAll: Reset everything to the platform's (all channels)
editor.resetTabDescription: The customisations of this tab are removed: the message becomes what the platform writes again. The previous version stays in the history.
editor.resetAllDescription: All customisations of this notification, on every channel, are removed. The previous versions stay in the history.

fields.title: Title
fields.colorAutomatic: Automatic (the category's or the kind of message's)
fields.aboveHint: The only place a mention really notifies somebody. Titles, places and names inserted by a variable never mention anybody.
fields.buttonUrlHint: Empty: the button opens the event or member page on the platform. Otherwise, an https:// address (a form, a website).
fields.subject: Subject of the e-mail
fields.preheaderHint: What the mail client shows after the subject.
fields.note: Note at the bottom of the message

items.help: Choose which information is shown, in which order, and under which name. A free sentence can be added.

repeat.name: repeat
repeat.label: The sentence that describes the repetition

link.name: link
link.label: Address of the page on the platform

actor.name: actor
actor.label: Who approved or removed the member

editor.name: editor
editor.label: Who changed or took back the event

cause.name: cause
cause.label: Why the event was taken back

intra_link.name: intra_link
intra_link.label: Address of the event on the intra

last.name: last
last.label: The last good backup, with its date and size

days.name: days
days.label: Number of days without a good backup

mentions.title: Mention on {platform}

help.discord: A mention targets a role or a person of the Discord server. Add here who can be mentioned: a readable name, and the identifier Discord gives (developer mode, right click, "Copy ID").
help.slack: A mention targets a group or a person of the Slack workspace. Add here who can be mentioned: a readable name, and the identifier Slack gives (profile or group, "Copy ID").

idHint.slack: Starts with U, W or S, for example U01ABCDE2F3.

mentions.listLabel: People and roles that can be mentioned
mentions.inUse: Not possible: this name is still used by {where}. Remove it from the message first.
mentions.staff: {@staff}: the staff members who gave their id

history.title: History: {scope}
history.description: The last 50 saved versions. Restoring a version creates a new one: nothing is lost.
history.failed: The history could not be loaded.
history.restoreDescription: This version becomes the current one, after being checked again. The current version stays in the history.
history.restoreDirty: This version becomes the current one. Unsaved changes on this page will be lost.

preview.title: Preview
preview.invalid: The template has an error: the preview shows the last valid version.
preview.failed: The preview could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
preview.disclaimer: Preview with an example event. Discord, Slack and each mail client draw things their own way: the test message shows the real result.

test.notConfigured: {channel} is not set up: an owner can do it in the settings.
test.rateLimited: A test has just been sent. Try again in {seconds} s.
test.failed: The test could not be sent: {detail}
test.invalid: The template has an error: fix it before testing.
test.liveMentions: Really notify the people mentioned during this test
test.liveDescription: During tests, mentions are written as plain text and notify nobody. Turning them on, the people and roles mentioned will get a notification, like a real message.

banners.fallbackTitle: The platform's own message was sent instead
banners.fallback: On {date}, this template could not be used ({reason}): the platform's own message went out in its place. Fix the template or go back to the default.
banners.acknowledgeDescription: The template stays as it is. This notice goes away until the next improvement.
banners.conflict: This template was changed by somebody else while you were editing. Reload the page to see their version, then redo your changes.
banners.notTicked: This notification is not sent on {channel} for now: an owner can tick the box in the settings.

fallbackReasons.render: the message could not be built

notices.customised: This channel now has its own template.
notices.resetAll: Every channel is back to the platform's message.

codes.badColor: A colour in the #rrggbb format is expected.
codes.badUrl: The address must start with https:// and lead to a website.
codes.duplicateItem: This information is already in the list.
codes.emailOnly: This field only exists for e-mails.
codes.mentionNotAllowed: Mentions are only possible in the text above the card.
codes.mentionNeedsChannel: This mention targets a specific person or role: customise it for a channel (Discord or Slack).
codes.mentionNotForChannel: This mention does not exist on this channel.
codes.notForEmail: An e-mail has no message above the card.
codes.tooManyTexts: Too many free texts (8 at most).
codes.unknownMention: This mention is not in the list: {mention}. Add it first.
codes.badMentionId: The identifier does not have the expected shape.
codes.conflict: Somebody changed this template in the meantime. Reload the page.
codes.channelNotForType: This notification is not sent on this channel.
codes.mentionInUse: This mention is still in use.
codes.notFound: Not found: it may have been changed already.
codes.restoreInvalid: This version is no longer valid today: it was not restored.
codes.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
codes.mentionNotForType: This mention is only for the messages to the staff about the intra.

secretField.leaveEmpty: Leave it empty to keep the one that is saved.
